events.content:
Created `app/server-timestamp.tsx` and wired it into `app/page.tsx:4`.

`unstable_noStore` from `next/cache` is Next.js's recommended opt-out from static prerendering for cases where you need fresh per-request data but don't want to read `cookies()`/`headers()` (which would also force dynamic rendering). Calling it at the top of the component marks the route as dynamic, so `new Date()` runs on every request. Typecheck passes.

part.text:
Created `app/server-timestamp.tsx` and wired it into `app/page.tsx:4`.

`unstable_noStore` from `next/cache` is Next.js's recommended opt-out from static prerendering for cases where you need fresh per-request data but don't want to read `cookies()`/`headers()` (which would also force dynamic rendering). Calling it at the top of the component marks the route as dynamic, so `new Date()` runs on every request. Typecheck passes.
